# `rnd` (research) publish lane — DESIGN / REVIEW

**Status:** proposal for DevOps review. Mirrors the existing `dev` lane so
`gtc-research install` can binstall the `-rnd` toolchain binaries, the same way
`gtc-dev install` installs the `-dev` ones.

## Why

The multi-provider Agentic Worker + per-tool `input_schema` work ships on the
`research` branches. Its runtime (`greentic-aw-runtime`) is `publish = false`, so
a usable binary can only be built from git deps — it exists today as the
`greentic-start v1.2.0-research.1` release + `greentic-start-distroless:research`
image, but **not** as a `*-rnd` crate/binary the `gtc-research` toolchain
installs. The `rnd` lane closes that gap.

## The three reusable workflows (mirror of `dev-*`)

| dev lane | rnd lane | difference |
|----------|----------|------------|
| `dev-prepare.yml` | `rnd-prepare.yml` | version comes **verbatim from Cargo.toml `X.Y.Z-research`** (no `RUN_ID` stamping); validates the `-research` suffix |
| `dev-release-binaries.yml` | `rnd-release-binaries.yml` | binary renamed to `<crate>-rnd`; archive `<crate>-rnd-v{version}-{target}`; release tagged `v<version>` |
| `dev-publish.yml` | `rnd-publish.yml` | bifurcates `<crate>` → `<crate>-rnd` and `cargo publish`es it at the `-research` version |

Pairing: `rnd-publish` publishes the `<crate>-rnd` crate (metadata + binstall
pkg-url) → `rnd-release-binaries` uploads the matching archive → `cargo binstall
<crate>-rnd --version <X.Y.Z-research>` resolves and downloads it. The
`--version` is required because the research version is a semver pre-release
(gtc-research pins it from the toolchain manifest) — this is the one deliberate
divergence from the dev lane, which regularizes its binary version.

## Caller (per repo, emitted by the sync script — see "open items")

Each toolchain repo gets an auto-generated `rnd-publish.yml` triggered on
`push: research`, e.g.:

```yaml
name: Rnd Publish
on:
  push:
    branches: [research]
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  rnd-prepare:
    uses: greenticai/.github/.github/workflows/rnd-prepare.yml@main
    secrets: inherit
  rnd-binaries-<pkg>:
    needs: rnd-prepare
    uses: greenticai/.github/.github/workflows/rnd-release-binaries.yml@main
    with: { package: <pkg>, version: ${{ needs.rnd-prepare.outputs.version }} }
  rnd-publish:
    needs: [rnd-prepare, rnd-binaries-<pkg>]
    uses: greenticai/.github/.github/workflows/rnd-publish.yml@main
    with:
      version: ${{ needs.rnd-prepare.outputs.version }}
      crates: "<deps-ordered crate list>"
      binary-crates: "<pkg>"
      dual-role-binary-crates: "<pkg>"
    secrets: inherit
```

## Open items for DevOps review

1. **Sync + manifest (REQUIRED before rollout).** The dev lane's per-repo
   callers are generated by `scripts/sync-dev-publish.sh` from
   `REPO_MANIFEST.toml`. A matching `sync-rnd-publish.sh` (or an extension of the
   existing one) + `REPO_MANIFEST` `rnd` entries must generate the per-repo
   `rnd-publish.yml` — NOT hand-edited. The lane stays dormant until this lands.
2. **Snapshot.** Pairs with `greentic-dev` PR #205 (the `release snapshot`
   resolver already picks `-research` versions for the `rnd` channel).

## Resolved in this PR

- **binstall on a pre-release version.** Decided: keep the verbatim
  `X.Y.Z-research` (a semver pre-release) for the `<crate>-rnd` binary. It sorts
  below stable on crates.io and `cargo binstall <crate>-rnd` requires
  `--version`, which `gtc-research install` already pins from the toolchain
  manifest. The dev lane's binary-version regularization is intentionally NOT
  carried over — it collides with the verbatim-version, no-`RUN_ID` scheme
  (a regular `X.Y.Z` would clash across `-research.0/.1/.2` bumps).
- **Residual dev-isms.** Bifurcation now uses `--suffix rnd`, so the crate
  actually publishes as `<crate>-rnd` (was `<crate>-dev`, which both targeted the
  wrong name and mismatched the `-rnd` archives). The dead `binary-version`
  re-stamp step and the `require-pre-release` input were removed; the inner-crate
  stamp call now uses the script's real `--dev-version` flag (was a non-existent
  `--rnd-version`, which hard-failed every run).

## Known limitation

- **Divergent inner crates.** `stamp-inner-crates.py` only understands `M.m.p` /
  `M.m.p-dev.N`. Research repos whose members share one
  `[workspace.package].version` are fine (no-op). A separately-versioned inner
  crate (the `greentic-deployer` + `greentic-deploy-spec` shape) is not yet
  supported on the rnd lane and would need script support before such a repo
  adopts a caller.

## Scope of the multi-provider + input_schema work (already shipped, research)

greentic-dw `b172a0c` · greentic-runner `34e2d12` · greentic-start
`v1.2.0-research.1` (+ `distroless:research`) — all carry multi-provider dw.agent
+ per-tool input_schema. This lane is purely about installing them via
`gtc-research install`.
